method: candidate lines proposed by corridor detection; identity decided from printed address runs and street-name labels
why_not_one_block_off: Sheet 56 covers 27th-30th, sheet 62 covers 30th-33rd, so the shared corridor is 30th St; both sheets print '30TH ST.' on the line, sheet 56 printing the adjoining sheet number '62' just south of it and sheet 62 printing '56' just north of it. Not one block off: sheet 56's blocks against the line carry the 29xx run (2901 2903 ... 2928, with 2911 1/2 and 2918 1/2 noted) and the 30th St frontage numbers 1002 1004 1006 1008 1010 1012 / 1014 1016 1018 1020 1022 1024; sheet 62's blocks below the line carry the 30xx run (3001 3003 ... 3018, with 3001 1/2 and 3012 1/2) and frontage 1001 1003 1005 1007 1009 1011 / 1015 1017 1019 1021 1023. Faces off the green ruler: sheet 56 north face y=3551 (the cand#1 line at y=3594 is the lot-number row, the true face is at 3551) and south face y=3791, center 3671, matching the '30TH ST.' label at y=3673; sheet 62 faces y=90.4 and y=332, center 211, matching its label at y=210. Drafted width 240 px on both = 70 ft.
